services.name: Anti-Cortisol Massage
services.description: Did you know that 9 out of 10 adults live under constant stress? Stress means cortisol, often called the “silent killer.” High cortisol affects sleep, digestion, hormones, energy, and even speeds up aging. Massage is scientifically proven to lower cortisol levels by up to 30%. Combined with Ayurvedic rituals, it’s one of the most effective natural ways to reset your nervous system. What’s Included in this Session ✔ Moderate-pressure Swedish & myofascial massage – focusing on shoulders, back, neck, and hips ✔ Diaphragm release + guided breathing – activate the vagus nerve and calm your system ✔ Scalp & foot ritual – finish with deep relaxation for better sleep ✔ Aromatherapy oils (lavender & bergamot) – enhance emotional and physiological calm ✔ Ayurvedic tea ritual after session – Tulsi and herbal blends proven to lower cortisol naturally Benefits You’ll Feel ✨ Stress hormone (cortisol) reduction up to 30% ✨ Lower blood pressure and calmer heart rate ✨ Improved sleep quality and digestion ✨ More energy, clarity, and emotional balance ✨ Long-term resilience with regular sessions (every 2–4 weeks) How to Prepare Before: hydrate, eat light, avoid alcohol/caffeine, arrive 5–10 minutes early. After: enjoy your Ayurvedic tea, drink warm water, rest, and avoid intense workouts for 12–24 hours.

services.name: CranioSacral therapy
services.description: Discover the transformative power of CranioSacral Therapy, a gentle, non-invasive treatment that focuses on enhancing the body's natural healing processes. CranioSacral Therapy (CST) was developed by Dr. John E. Upledger, an osteopathic physician. Dr. Upledger's work in the 1970s and 1980s was pivotal in refining and popularizing CST. He discovered and explored the craniosacral system, which involves the membranes and cerebrospinal fluid surrounding the brain and spinal cord. His research and clinical observations led to the development of techniques to assess and treat restrictions in this system, which he found could help alleviate a wide range of health issues. This holistic approach aims to relieve pain and tension, improve overall health, and promote deep relaxation by addressing imbalances in the craniosacral system, which includes the membranes and fluids surrounding the brain and spinal cord. Benefits of CranioSacral Therapy: - Relieves chronic pain and tension - Reduces stress and promotes relaxation - Enhances overall health and well-being - Improves mobility and flexibility - Supports emotional balance and mental clarity What to Expect During a Session: - A calm, supportive environment - Gentle touch techniques to assess and release restrictions - Personalized care tailored to your unique needs - Deep relaxation and a sense of profound well-being Experience the subtle yet powerful benefits of CranioSacral Therapy and embark on a journey toward more excellent health and harmony. Book your session today and let your body’s innate healing potential flourish!

services.name: Shirodhara session
services.description: Experience the ancient Ayurvedic therapy of Shirodhara, a deeply relaxing and rejuvenating treatment that promotes mental clarity and emotional balance. The word "Shirodhara" comes from the Sanskrit words "Shiro" (head) and "Dhara" (flow), reflecting the continuous stream of warm herbal oil gently poured over the forehead. Benefits: Stress Relief: Shirodhara induces a state of deep relaxation, reducing stress and anxiety levels. Improved Sleep: This therapy is known to enhance the quality of sleep by calming the nervous system. Mental Clarity: Regular sessions help improve focus and mental clarity, supporting overall cognitive function. Emotional Balance: Shirodhara helps to balance emotions and promote a sense of peace and well-being. Hair and Scalp Health: The herbal oils nourish the scalp and strengthen hair roots. What to Expect: During a Shirodhara session, you will lie comfortably on a massage table. Warm, herbal oil will be gently poured in a continuous stream over your forehead, particularly the "third eye" area. This process lasts for about 30 to 45 minutes, during which you may experience a deep meditative state. Holistic Approach: Shirodhara is part of a holistic Ayurvedic treatment plan aimed at balancing the body's energy (doshas). It is particularly effective in addressing Vata and Pitta imbalances, which are associated with stress, anxiety, and mental agitation. Why Choose Shirodhara: Traditional Wisdom: Rooted in ancient Ayurvedic traditions, Shirodhara offers time-tested benefits for mental and emotional health. Comprehensive Healing: Combines physical relaxation with emotional and mental rejuvenation. Personalized Treatment: Our therapists customize the herbal oil blend based on your unique constitution and needs.
